intro: Lesson 92: Reading for facts: plants that surprise us (VIPERS). Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

passage.title: Teacher-written information text for TGA
paras: Sunflowers can grow taller than a grown-up. Young sunflowers turn to face the sun. Birds and people eat their seeds.
The Venus flytrap grows in wet, boggy places. When an insect touches tiny hairs on its leaf, the leaf snaps shut.

questions.q: Which way do young sunflowers turn?
Core: write two facts for our class 'Did you know?' file
questions.a: For example: Did you know? Sunflowers can grow taller than a grown-up.

questions.q: Extend: which fact surprised you most? Say why with because
questions.a: For example: The flytrap, because plants do not usually move.

questions.q: Stretch: write a question you would like to find out
questions.a: For example: How tall is the tallest sunflower?

questions.q: What makes the flytrap leaf snap shut?
questions.a: B) an insect touching tiny hairs. The text says the leaf snaps shut when an insect touches tiny hairs on it.
